display.purpose: Net worth and one headline figure per dashboard.

body.purpose: Default text and table cells, tabular numerals for amounts.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single main action on a view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #c67e48; color: #fff; padding: 10px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; font: 500 15px Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #b67443; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(198,126,72,0.16); }

components.name: Summary Card
components.description: Resting card for a figure or list.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; color: #413935; border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(68,48,34,0.05), 0 3px 10px rgba(68,48,34,0.035); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-card-label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: #595754; } .ds-card-value { font-size: 28px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview: A well-kept paper ledger on a warm desk: calm surfaces, one copper accent, and numbers that are easy to trust.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper background with white cards; soft warm shadows.
One accent (copper) for primary actions and selected states.
Tabular, right-aligned numerals for every amount.
Gain and loss shown by sign and icon first, color second.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Copper appears on at most one primary action per view plus selected state.

rules.name: The Sign Before Color Rule
rules.body: Every gain or loss shows + or - and color only reinforces it.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: All amounts, quantities, prices and percentages use tabular numerals and are right-aligned in tables.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Elements are flat at rest; larger shadows appear only on overlays.

dos: Do reuse Vuetify and Framework7 components and the --ebk-* tokens before writing custom CSS.
Do show amounts with tabular numerals, right-aligned.
Do design empty, loading and error states for every new screen.
Do keep light and dark mode both working at WCAG AA.
donts: Don't use color alone for gain or loss.
Don't add a second accent color or a rainbow chart palette.
Don't nest cards inside cards or add decorative gradients.
Don't hardcode hex values in components; use theme colors and tokens.
